title: Installer asks for admin rights
symptom: Installing approved software asks for an administrator password
user_description: I need to install the new reporting tool the company approved, but it keeps asking for an admin password.

options.why: Admin rights let a user install anything, including harmful software. The need is one install, not permanent power.

options.text: Share the admin password with him
options.why: Never share administrator credentials. Everything done with them would be untraceable.

options.text: Confirm the software is approved, then install it with your own admin account or through the company's software deployment tool
options.why: Approved software should be installed by IT or a managed tool. This keeps control without handing the user powers he does not need.

options.text: Tell him to turn off User Account Control
options.why: Turning off the prompt removes an important protection for the whole PC.

hints: Is the software on the approved list?
Is there a way to install it without giving him admin power?
real_world_tip: A self-service software portal lets users install approved tools without admin rights. It is worth suggesting.
